scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @intelekia/shared" "npm run dev -w @intelekia/api" "npm run dev -w @intelekia/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @intelekia/shared && npm run build -w @intelekia/api && npm run build -w @intelekia/web
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d postgres
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:deploy -w @intelekia/api && npm run db:seed
